projects.name: Workflow Tool
projects.description: A tool for managing the workflow of the candidates and the interviewers
myContribution: Lead Architecture design and development from design to production
Collaborate with the backend team for the integration of the features
Collaborate with product team, CS team and other stakeholders for the roadmap planning and feature development
projects.technologyUsageDescription: Led architecture design and development from design to production to build using Nx workspace (monorepo architecture) with React, TypeScript and TailwindCSS, bundled with Webpack for code-splitting and lazy loading. Implemented new features consuming Hasura GraphQL server with Apollo Client and maintained client data in Redux reducer/slice processed through Redux Saga. Utilized Hasura Subscriptions through WebSocket for real-time updates. Maintained the application by conducting code reviews and wrote unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library. Managed deployment pipeline with containerized deployment using Docker and automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Implemented error tracking and monitoring with Sentry. Collaborated with backend team for feature integration and with product team, CS team and stakeholders for roadmap planning and feature development

projects.name: Teserra Components Library
projects.description: A library of components for the Teserra platform
projects.technologyUsageDescription: Led architecture design and setup to build reusable component library with React and TypeScript in monorepo structure. Styled components with TailwindCSS and built accessible components using Shadcn/ui on top of Radix UI primitives. Documented components in Storybook with interactive examples and automated visual regression testing with Chromatic. Wrote unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library, and end-to-end tests with Cypress for component integration scenarios. Reviewed and approved components

projects.name: Candidate Web Application V2
projects.description: A platform where candidates can take the test and live interview and manage their availability
myContribution: Architecture design and development from design to production
Migrate legacy code to new architecture
Collaborate with the backend team for the integration of the features
Collaborate with product team for the roadmap planning and feature development
projects.technologyUsageDescription: Designed and developed architecture from design to production to architect micro-frontend application with React and TypeScript, migrated legacy code from Ember.js and JavaScript to new architecture. Managed micro-frontend architecture with Webpack Module Federation for runtime module sharing between independent deployable frontend modules. Integrated RESTful API endpoints for candidate data, test results and scheduling, and managed state in each micro-frontends with Redux. Managed deployment pipeline by containerizing individual micro-frontend applications with Docker and setting up CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions for independent deployments. Implemented error monitoring with Sentry. Collaborated with backend team for feature integration and with product team for roadmap planning and feature development.

projects.name: Proview Live Proctor
projects.description: A platform for invigilators to monitor the candidates during the test and live interview
myContribution: Architecture design and development from design to production
Collaborate with the backend team for the integration of the features
Collaborate with product team for the feature development
projects.technologyUsageDescription: Led architecture design and development from design to production to build real-time proctoring dashboard with React and JavaScript for invigilators to monitor candidates activity collected from the Proview Client. Pulled that through RESTful API including monitoring logic and activity tracking, displayed candidate data in sortable, filterable tables with react-table and styled with Semantic UI. Integrated videoJs for streaming HLS video for live monitoring, and enabled real-time bidirectional communication chat-bot with Getstream.io(WebSocket). Bundled application with Webpack. Managed deployment pipeline with containerized deployment using Docker and automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Implemented error tracking with Sentry. Collaborated with backend, media team, product team for feature integration and feature development
